scope: Local prepared snapshot only. Candidates are lower-closing-TAC same-aircraft WOs, optionally matching ATA. These are NOT validated symptoms, precursors, independent failure episodes, or predictive samples.

definitions.exact: Raw parsed part number exactly equals requested PN; no case or punctuation normalization.
definitions.normalized: Uppercase alphanumeric only, matching existing repo part_key logic.
definitions.eligible_serial_swap: Both stripped uppercased serials present and different; closing TAC present. Does not establish failure or unscheduled removal.
definitions.primary_target_event: Eligible swap with requested PN on the removed/off side.
definitions.candidate_pair: Distinct (replacement WO UUID, earlier WO UUID). One pair may represent many physical changes and pairs may share a replacement or earlier WO; these are not necessarily independent episodes.
definitions.ata4: First two hyphen-separated two-digit ATA groups.
